im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# Print a horizontal row at several y values, marking color changes compactly
for y in [5, 50, 82, 85, 100, 130, 140]:
    row = im[y]
    # compress into runs of quantized color
    q = (row//32)*32
    runs=[]

    for x in range(1,256):

            runs.append((start,x-1,tuple(q[start])))
